university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology
program_name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Management Mathematics with Computing

fees.notes: TAR UMT official programme page lists RM74,000 as the total international fee for the full programme (inclusive of 6% SST; covers all fees payable to TAR UMT, excluding EMGS and immigration charges; the page states fees may vary by 10%). Source: https://focs.tarc.edu.my/programmes/bachelor-degree/bachelor-of-science-honours-in-management-mathematics-with-computi-rmm (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects (4) Other IHL : Foundation relevant accredited by MQA (5) TAR UC - Foundation in Computing (Track A) OR Relevant Diploma Compulsory subjects: i) (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Credit/ O Level Grade C in Mathematics/ UEC Grade B in one mathematics subject ii) (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language* *Grade C and above in AELE0364 English Language conducted by TAR UC is accepted as having fulfilled the English Language requirement for applicants who fail English Language at SPM/O Level/UEC. Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Higher Education latest requirements.
